input.objective: Identify the exact San Francisco city agency responsible for this issue and the official reporting channel with its URL. Issue category: streetlight. Prefer official city government pages such as sf.gov and 311.

value.title: Report a problem with a streetlight | SF.gov
value.excerpt: Report a streetlight that is out, flickering or damaged. The San Francisco Public Utilities Commission maintains most city streetlights and SF 311 routes the request.

value.title: 311 Customer Service Center | SF.gov
value.excerpt: SF 311 is the city's single point of contact for non emergency service requests. Call 311, use the web forms, or use the SF311 mobile app.
